release: Windows Defender LF Build Pipeline Hotfix
name: Windows Defender LF Build Pipeline Hotfix
changes: Keeps the complete v3.6.77 application/runtime/UX payload unchanged apart from release identity.
Builds NewzDeckYenc.exe in a dedicated pinned Linux GitHub Actions job from the exact canonical LF Git source bytes using Go 1.23.2 and the already accepted -H windowsgui profile.

Requires the canonical yEnc source SHA-256 ba11eea2f880a934ff24f73be1cb12f0341456d5972c71f9c860efe9b3673edd and Defender-tested helper SHA-256 4bb07f7b6d38ff99313f74cb4b45555e134af7106e32d55b106a79d603204fad before the Windows release job can package Setup/Portable assets.
No browsing, download, SABnzbd, Automation, Smart Import, Discover, Settings, launcher/service/tray, Metadata Server or yEnc decoder behavior changes are included.
regression_guards: server.py, sab_engine.py, automation_engine.py and app.js must normalize byte-for-byte to v3.6.77 after replacing only the v3.6.78 identity.
static/index.html must normalize byte-for-byte to v3.6.77 after replacing only the version/cache identity, and styles.css must remain byte-for-byte v3.6.77.
NewzDeckYenc.go remains frozen at Git blob 38f6df7ed77bc7d3b5d8c83b1973e86fc6fa9c15 and canonical LF SHA-256 ba11eea2f880a934ff24f73be1cb12f0341456d5972c71f9c860efe9b3673edd.
The canonical release must consume the dedicated Linux-built helper and reject any helper whose SHA-256 is not 4bb07f7b6d38ff99313f74cb4b45555e134af7106e32d55b106a79d603204fad.

All established schema-11 browsing, five-Image/six-Video admission, 24 MB/12-segment sampling, 800/800/1000 headers, resolver timing, Settings reliability, SABnzbd 5.1.2, terminal-history schema 3, Smart Import and Automation protections remain carried forward.
